cohort: 6,054 women aged 18 years or older who had given birth in Switzerland within the previous 12 months
finding: An estimated 26.7% of women experienced some form of informal coercion during childbirth, and this experience was associated with a higher risk of postpartum depression and lower satisfaction with childbirth.
mod_finding: Cesarean section and instrumental vaginal birth were associated with an increased risk of informal coercion compared to vaginal delivery.
